subject: Math
prompt: During the first week a library was open, $800,000$ books were checked out. During the same week, $12%$ of the books checked out were not renewed. If checkouts and the non-renewal rate remain the same for each of the next $7$ weeks, about how many books will not be renewed during this $8$-week period?
explanation: Choice C is correct. Of the $800{,}000$ books checked out during the first week, $12\%$ were not renewed, so $800{,}000 \times 0.12 = 96{,}000$ books were not renewed during the first week. If books were checked out and not renewed at the same rate for each of the next $7$ weeks, then a total of $96{,}000 \times 8 = 768{,}000$ books were not renewed during the $8$-week period.
